column1: # NekoRPG skills — zh <TAB> en <TAB> note.  Source: NekoRPG/src/skills.js
# Skill NAMES: 110 of 111 already in Script.txt (itemNames "skill names" block). Only 战斗 missing.
# Milestones carry no display text (code-only skill-unlock refs).
# DESCRIPTIONS: 14 not yet in script — translated directly (not via DeepSeek) because each is
#   dense with 【bracketed】 glossary terms DeepSeek would break; all embedded terms below are
#   reconciled to the existing glossary. These are static strings (no ${} interp) → safe for
#   exact-match DOM replacement under #skill_list.
# === MISSING NAME ===
# 战斗 MOVED to 08_more_terms.tsv. It has to be a FRAGMENT, not an exact entry:
# the message log renders "${skill.name()} 达到了 level 18" and our whole-node
# regex inserts the captured name verbatim, so an exact-only name survives as
# "战斗 reached level 18". Same cause as 合成 (v8.0). See audit_messages.py.
# Exact (not a fragment) so it fires in the precise early pass, ahead of
# applyItemNames. That rewrites [融血术] -> [Merge Blood Technique], after which
# the equivalent v4.0 #skill_list pair can never match - a bug that predates the
# prose layer, since applyItemNames has always run before the buttons pass.
增加[融血术]秘法的使用效果
column2: Increases the effect of using the [Merge Blood Technique] Technique
